lines: can't read the words on the menu
turns down the radio
I USED TO BE ADDICTED TO TIDE PODS
I'M CLEAN NOW
IN CHURCH THEY ASKED ME WHAT A BISHOP DOES
APPARENTLY "MOVE DIAGONALLY" WAS NOT THE ANSWER THEY WERE LOOKING FOR
IF I GOT 50 CENTS FOR EVERY FAILED MATH EXAM
I'D HAVE $ 6.30 NOW
EBAY IS SO USELESS
I TRIED TO LOOK UP LIGHTERS AND ALL THEY HAD WAS 13,749 MATCHES
EARTH IS THE BEST WORLD IN THE PLANET
MY GIRLFRIEND BROKE UP WITH ME BECAUSE I STOLE HER WHEELCHAIR
I KNEW SHE'D COME CRAWLING BACK
THANKS FOR EXPLAINING THE WORD "MANY" TO ME
IT MEANS A LOT
AFTER CUTTING THE UMBILICAL CORD
BABIES BECOME WIRELESS
ANYONE WHO SAYS THEIR WEDDING DAY WAS THE BEST DAY OF THEIR LIFE
HAS OBVIOUSLY NEVER HAD 2 CANDY BARS FALL DOWN AT ONCE FROM A VENDING MACHINE
APPLE SHOULD MAKE A BIGSCREEN TV AND CALL IT THE BIG MAC
I OFTEN GET A "YES" FROM WOMEN
BUT IT'S USUALLY FOLLOWED BY "THAT'S HIM OFFICER"
90% OF PEOPLE ARE STUPID
GLAD I'M THE OTHER 20%
LAST NIGHT THE PIZZA DELIVERY GUY GAVE ME MY PIZZA FOR FREE BECAUSE HE WAS SO LATE
I THOUGHT THAT WAS REALLY COOL SINCE I NEVER ORDERED A PIZZA
I THINK IT'S PRETTY COOL
THAT THE CHINESE MADE A WHOLE LANGUAGE OUT OF TATTOOS
I CAN TOTALLY KEEP SECRETS
IT'S THE PEOPLE I TELL THEM TO THAT CAN'T
SPIDERS ARE LIKE LAND OCTOPUSES
I DREAMT I WAS DROWNING IN AN OCEAN OF ORANGE SODA BUT IT WAS JUST A FANTA SEA
TODAY IN CHURCH THEY ASKED ME WHAT A BISHOP DOES
APPARENTLY "MOVE DIAGONALLY" WAS NOT THE ANSWER THEY WERE LOOKING FOR
I'VE BEEN REPEATING THE SAME MISTAKES IN LIFE FOR SO LONG NOW
I THINK I'LL START CALLING THEM TRADITIONS

meaning.meaning_en: This meme uses a photo of a man with a smug, self-assured expression to represent someone who is confidently stating a fact that is completely wrong, absurd, or logically incoherent. The humor comes from the gap between the speaker's total confidence and the obvious stupidity of their statement. The first text box usually contains the nonsensical or incorrect claim, while the second box often provides the context or the absurd consequence of that claim.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieses Meme verwendet ein Foto eines Mannes mit einem selbstbewussten, überheblichen Gesichtsausdruck, um jemanden darzustellen, der mit voller Überzeugung etwas sagt, das völlig falsch, absurd oder logisch inkohärent ist. Der Humor entsteht durch den Kontrast zwischen der totalen Selbstsicherheit des Sprechers und der offensichtlichen Dummheit seiner Aussage. Das erste Textfeld enthält in der Regel die unsinnige oder falsche Behauptung, während das zweite Feld oft den Kontext oder die absurde Konsequenz dieser Behauptung liefert.
situations_en: I just learned that the moon is made of cheese
I think water is a gas
My cat is actually a dog
I counted 10 fingers on my left hand
situations_de: Ich habe gerade gelernt, dass der Mond aus Käse besteht
Ich denke, Wasser ist ein Gas
Meine Katze ist eigentlich ein Hund
Ich habe 10 Finger an meiner linken Hand gezählt
